text: 62-year-old female presents with 6-month history of intermittent rectal bleeding, change in bowel habits, and unintentional weight loss of 20 lbs. Patient reports increasing fatigue and occasional abdominal cramping. Family history significant for colon cancer in father at age 65. No prior colonoscopy. Physical examination reveals mild pallor and left lower quadrant tenderness. Digital rectal exam shows palpable mass approximately 8 cm from anal verge. Labs show iron deficiency anemia (Hgb 9.2 g/dL). Urgent colonoscopy scheduled. Patient counseled regarding high suspicion for colorectal malignancy.
